source: UCI Machine Learning Repository — Thyroid Disease (ann-thyroid subset)
original_source: Garavan Institute of Sydney, Australia / Ross Quinlan
description: Preprocessed thyroid disease records for backpropagation benchmarking. Determines whether a patient is hypothyroid (subnormal functioning), hyperfunction, or normal.
transformations: Combined ann-train.data (3,772) and ann-test.data (3,428) into single dataset
Added column names based on Quinlan's hypothyroid schema (15 binary + 6 continuous indicators)
Engineered: TSH/T3 ratio (clinical indicator), calculated FTI (TT4 × T4U)
Scaled with StandardScaler (on train, transform test)
licensing: UCI ML Repository — no specific license; research use only
